objective: Supplementary scalar evaluation against mixed tables. Excluded from selection and from the six-cell primary metric.
game: game.Game.auto_simulate, 1000-turn limit, actual randomAgent.AgentRandom, same deterministic temporal factories as the primary evaluation.
pairing: Use each focal seat and every distinct clockwise ordering of its peers. Reset both the Python and NumPy RNGs to the deal seed immediately before each game in each arm.
outcome: Focal wins divided by all games, including draws. Report candidate minus baseline, with pointwise two-sided 95% paired normal intervals over independent deals within each roster.
